meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP expert. Create a shorter tour: 1) Start at city 0 and use NEAREST-NEIGHBOR to visit unvisited cities. 2) Prioritize geographic coherence - avoid edge crossings and maintain cluster ordering. 3) Verify all 20 cities appear exactly once. Connect nearby cities consecutively and avoid long jumps. After construction, improve the tour by swapping cities to reduce crossings. Check that every city from 0 to 19 is visited exactly once. Output exactly one tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format where c1=0 and c1..c20 is a permutation of 0..19.
